scope: Ordinary English nonfoil Legends, 488 by 680 canonical comparison pixels.
finding: Inherited top and bottom gradient bands crossed title and artist lettering. Earlier metrics using that template are historical evidence, not frame-only validation.
policy: Frame-only outer strips with clamped search padding. Translation/uniform scale against fixed calibration scans. Separate along-edge strips validate the frozen pose; no text, art, renderer geometry or per-card renderer adjustments.

geometryRecheck.policy: Unchanged runtime-verified frame/art candidates compared against corrected scan poses, without geometry search. Signed grayscale boundary correlation, not whole-card accuracy. Outer sampling excludes lettering and smoothing padding is clamped.

colorRecheck.policy: Recheck unchanged prepared frame/paper and mana colors on corrected scan poses. Fixed patches, masks and symbol circles; no color refitting. Oklab distances are not accuracy percentages.

remaining: Gold frame geometry improves the group mean, but Torsten Von Ursus boundary correlation regresses from 0.7248 to 0.6661; inspect before release.
Land outer-frame color improves overall, but shadow-lightness error rises from 4.0385 to 4.7027, exceeding the 0.25 regression guard. Refit or constrain the land adjustment before release.
Audit inherited Alpha/Beta/Revised sampling bands; the Legends finding alone does not establish their correctness or failure.
